1    
A cylinder has a radius of 5 cm and a height of 12 cm. 
     
Work out the volume of the cylinder. 
Give your answer in terms of π.
12 cm 
 
(3 marks)

2    
A cylinder has a diameter of 9 cm and a height 
of 11 cm. 
     
Work out the volume of the cylinder. 
Give your answer correct to 1 decimal place.
9 cm  
(3 marks)

3    
A solid cylinder has a radius of 4 cm
and a height of 10.5 cm. 
10.5 
cm  
     
Work out the total surface area of the cylinder. 
Give your answer correct to 1 decimal place.
(3 marks)

4   
A solid cylinder has a diameter of 7 cm
and a height of 15 cm. 
     
Work out the total surface area of the cylinder. 
Give your answer correct to 3 significant figures.
7 cm  
(3 marks)

5    
A solid cylinder has a radius of 6 m and 
a height of 7 m. 
     
Work out the total surface area of the cylinder. 
Give your answer in terms of π.
7 m

6    
A solid cylinder has a radius of 14 cm 
and a height of 25 cm. 
25 cm  
     
Work out the volume of the cylinder. 
Give your answer correct to 
3 significant figures. 
14 cm

7    
A solid cylinder is cut in half to form a semi-cylinder with a radius of 
20 cm and a length of 75 cm. 
75 cm

8    
A solid is formed by placing a half cylinder on a rectangular prism. 
The solid has a width of 2 m, a total height of 3 m and a length of 8 m.
8 m  
3 m  
2 m  
     
Work out the volume of the solid. 
Give your answer correct to 3 significant figures.
(4 marks)

9    
A solid cylinder has a radius of r m and a
height of 12 m. 
     
The volume of the cylinder is 507π m 3.
Find the value of r. 
12 m  
r m  
(4 marks)

10    
A solid cylinder has a radius of 5 m and a height of h  m. 
     
The total surface area of the cylinder is 165π m 2.
Find the value of h. 
h m  
5 m  
(4 marks)

11  
The diagram shows a cylindrical tank. 
The tank has a top and a bottom.

12   A cylinder has a diameter of 9 cm and a height of 11 cm. 
       (a)  Work out the volume of the cylinder. 
       Give your answer correct to 1 decimal place.
11 cm  
        (b)  The volume of another cylinder is 1500 cm 2. 
        Michael says that 1500cm 2 is the same as 15 m 2. 
9 cm
        Is Michael correct?
        You must give a reason for your answer.
(4 marks)

13   The diagram shows an empty tank in the shape of    
       a cylinder.
12 cm  
       The cylinder has radius 12 cm and height 45 cm.
45 cm  
       Water flows into the tank at a rate of 1.8 litres per    
       minute.
 
       Calculate the number of minutes it will take to         
       completely fill the tank.
       Give your answer correct to the nearest minute.
(4 marks)
